title: George Stewart, the clarinetist who worked with all the bands
summary: Glass says George Stewart was slim like George Lewis and worked in the Camellia, Excelsior and any band picking the best men for parades.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Oh, who is this guy George Stewart? George Stewart? Yeah, the clarinet player. Yeah, he did, yeah. Is he dead or alive or was he dead?
I believe George Stewart dead, I don't know what you're talking about. George Bendy and I.
George Stewart just played for the Alibaba, and that's a regular job.
He was slim like George Lewis. He just was slim like George Lewis.
And who did he play with? What band? I didn't get that.

Well he used to work with all the bands, you know. He'd work in with the Camellia Band, Excelsior, he'd work anywhere. You see that's the way they'd hire the fellas, all in between. It's like how all the fellas, they know how all that's good, they'd get him. You see you have to pick out your best mans to go out on these street parades and things like that. And that's how we worked it.
